html: † [תְּלַת] n.[m.] a third part (so 𝔗 תֻּלְתָּא, תַּלְתָּא, Syriac ܬܽܘܠܬܳܐ, Nab. תלת SAC 121, Arabic ثُلُثٌ, ثُلْثٌ, Assyrian šulultu (= šuluštu) MeissnSuppl. 95, cf. DlWB; v. also M88 Dr Dn 5:7);—emph. תַּלְתָּא adv. as one of three Dn 5:16, 29 (Bev the third day, every three days, v. So in M 88).
